key_insight: Buoyancy-driven flow synchronizes selected cylinders in a 3×3 array, whereas a 4×4 array exhibits forced buffeting without synchronization.
engineering_relevance: Cylinder-array layout can alter vibration and heat transfer in naturally cooled tube bundles, making thermal and structural performance important to assess together.
method: Simulate heated cylinder arrays in a square enclosure at Pr = 7 and Ra = 10⁷.
Couple thermal, fluid, and structural dynamics using a body-fitted arbitrary Lagrangian–Eulerian finite-element formulation.
Compare stationary and elastically mounted 3×3 and 4×4 arrays.
evidence_signal: The 3×3 left-column cylinders lock in to a nondimensional plume frequency of 0.183 at reduced velocity 15.7; array-wide heat transfer changes negligibly for 3×3 but increases measurably for 4×4.
watch_item: Results are reported at one Prandtl–Rayleigh parameter pair, so broader operating-range applicability requires further evaluation.
paper_title: Flow-induced vibration of an array of circular cylinders in a square enclosure due to thermal buoyancy
